implementation.capabilityModel: UpdateCapabilities{latest_only, manual_pinned_command} is computed per manager and carried on every PackageManagerUpdatePreview, including blocked ones, because the limit belongs to the entry point rather than to one attempt
implementation.honestSplit: latest_only describes what *this* entry point offers; manual_pinned_command exposes the manager's own documented version-pinned command where one exists, so the user can act instead of being told 'no'
implementation.noInvention: yarn (pins per project, not per machine), bun (documents no pinned self upgrade), pipx/cargo/dotnet (no general self-update) all report None — None means 'no verified one-liner', never 'impossible'
implementation.ui: The preview dialog now renders 版本范围 (latest-only explanation) and, when present, 指定版本需手动执行 with the exact template, replacing the misleading blanket claim
